abstract: We have assessed the tumour markers placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP), lactate dehydrogenase (LD), and human chorionic gonadotrophin (beta HCG) using 2,000 serum samples from 286 patients with seminoma. The ROC curves show that no one marker performs adequately for the detection of disease either at initial staging or during follow-up. We used a Markov model heuristically to devise strategies, in which marker results were assessed in combination, which might be useful in clinical practice. We found that the best strategy was to consider a test result abnormal only if either the beta HCG was greater than 6 Ul-1 or the LD was greater than 400 U l-1 and the PLAP level was greater than 60 U l-1. This will detect about 50% of patients with disease and the false-positive rate is 2%. In practical terms this means that PLAP need only be estimated in patients whose beta HCG is less than 6 IU l-1 and whose LD is greater than 400 U l-1.
abstract_ja: セミノーマ患者286例の血清2,000検体を用いて、腫瘍マーカーである胎盤性アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)、乳酸脱水素酵素(LD)、β-hCGを評価した。ROC曲線によれば、いずれか単独のマーカーでは、病期分類時にもフォローアップ時にも病変の検出に十分な性能を示さなかった。マルコフモデルを用いて、マーカー結果を組み合わせて評価する戦略を経験的に検討した。最良の戦略は、β-hCGが6 IU/l超、またはLDが400 U/l超かつPLAPが60 U/l超の場合に限り、結果を異常とみなす方法であった。この方法では病変を有する患者の約50%を検出でき、偽陽性率は2%である。実際には、β-hCGが6 IU/l未満かつLDが400 U/l超の患者でのみPLAPを測定すればよい。
